title: Universal Background Check Act
summary: Requires background checks for all firearm sales, including private sales.

title: Permitless Carry Expansion Act
summary: Removes permit requirements to carry a handgun.

title: Reproductive Access Protection Act
summary: Protects access to abortion services up to fetal viability.

title: Heartbeat Protection Act
summary: Prohibits most abortions after cardiac activity is detected.

title: Border Enforcement Funding Act
summary: Increases funding for border enforcement and detention.

title: Pathway to Residency Act
summary: Creates a path to legal residency for long-term undocumented residents.

title: Medicaid Expansion Act
summary: Expands Medicaid eligibility to adults up to 138% of the poverty line.

title: Health Program Spending Cap Act
summary: Caps annual growth in public health program spending.

title: Clean Energy Standard Act
summary: Sets a target for utilities to reach 80% clean electricity.

title: Energy Permitting Relief Act
summary: Shortens environmental review for fossil fuel projects.

title: Income Tax Relief Act
summary: Cuts income tax rates across brackets.

title: Revenue Restoration Act
summary: Raises the top tax rate to fund public services.

title: Education Freedom Scholarship Act
summary: Creates vouchers usable at private schools.

title: Public School Funding Guarantee Act
summary: Bars public education funds from going to private schools.

title: Fair Wage Act
summary: Raises the minimum wage in steps to $15 per hour.

title: Wage Preemption Act
summary: Prevents local governments from setting their own minimum wage.

title: Safer Streets Act
summary: Increases police funding and penalties for violent crime.

title: Police Accountability Act
summary: Creates civilian oversight boards and limits no-knock warrants.

title: Election Integrity Act
summary: Requires photo ID to vote and more frequent roll purges.

title: Ballot Access Act
summary: Expands early voting and automatic voter registration.

title: Cannabis Regulation Act
summary: Legalizes and regulates adult-use marijuana.

title: Drug-Free Communities Act
summary: Increases penalties for marijuana possession.

title: Equality in Employment Act
summary: Adds sexual orientation and gender identity to anti-discrimination law.

title: Religious Liberty in Services Act
summary: Lets businesses refuse services that conflict with religious beliefs.

title: General Appropriations Act
summary: Funds government operations for the fiscal year.

title: Infrastructure Investment Act
summary: Funds roads, bridges and broadband.

title: Veterans Services Improvement Act
summary: Expands mental health services for veterans.

title: Regulatory Review Act
summary: Requires legislative approval for major new regulations.
